title: DTN C: implement S-flag hop-by-hop expiry option (App Data Type 0x03 absolute expiry)
description: Child of b7z9.8. The DTN wire format (S flag in IPv6 hop-by-hop options carrying absolute expiry, App Data Type 0x03) is absent in the C implementation: packet->dtn_expiry_unix is caller-populated and only test code populates it (lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/src/main.c:395); docs/spec-chapter-breakdowns.md:415-417 lists HBH option work as pending. Implement per spec 05-routing.md 9.8: parse/format the HBH expiry option in the C routing path so forwarded DTN messages carry absolute expiry instead of relying on caller plumbing. Must land AFTER b7z9.8.1 (wall-clock fail-open) so expiry semantics are settled; sibling parity in Rust/Python is b7z9.8.3.
close_reason: Verification-close: both children complete. .2.2 (closed): the C routing path parses the Type=0x03 HBH option (S-flag + absolute expiry) in parse_ipv6_dispatch and the DTN store decision consumes ONLY the wire values — the caller-supplied dtn_expiry_unix field was removed entirely (lichena_l2/l2... i.e. struct lichen_route_packet), with R-05-080 fail-open when now_unix==0 and wrap-safe expiry comparison (75b86d62cd). .2.3 (closed): the full admission matrix in tests/routing_dispatch (20 cases: malformed TLVs, unknown action bits, HBH-not-first, reserved-bits-ignored, S-flag with valid/zero/garbage/half-space expiry, wraparound, forward-path-vs-store precedence, expire boundary matrix) — suite green under gcc-14 with ASan/UBSan and -Werror. Forwarded DTN messages now carry absolute expiry per spec 05-routing 9.8; the legacy dtn.c expiry comparison nit is tracked separately.
